scope: Direct resumable helpers in mixed CPU/Apple GPU programs, including transitive/nonfallible wrappers, helper-owned groups and completed host results.

semantics.classification: Direct task/control/placement/error effects propagate through resolved callers; effectful functions are not exported through the synchronous CPU ABI.
semantics.direct_calls: Each invocation expands into separate continuation slots with a function failure boundary and distinct lexical groups. Numeric callees remain checked target calls.
semantics.groups: Helper scopes nest under the ambient group, or own their work without an outer main scope. Group-directed failures still settle at their joins.
semantics.errors: Declared TaskError channels may propagate or return expected failures; callers may catch settled failures. Fully recovering wrappers need no exposed error channel.
semantics.memory: Existing immutable captures, Buffer leases, scheduler and completion ownership remain unchanged. Functions return completed host values; device selectors and task handles cannot escape.
semantics.limits: Spawning resumable mixed helpers is explicitly rejected. Child frames/captures/cancellation support is next. Existing recursion/depth and frame-slot limits apply.
semantics.numerics: No new arithmetic, type, shader capability or numerical-policy change. All prior recorded numerical artifacts match.

coverage: helper-owned scope without outer main scope
normal and instrumented compiler emission matches

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Function composition/correctness increment; no performance claim.
